newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WORLD CUP SLALOM WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WORLD CUP SLALOM WINNER.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of Pernilla Wiberg, winner of a women's World Cup slalom on Saturday:

World Cup wins: 16. Slalom: Bad Kleinkirchheim (91), Waterville (91), Narvik (92) Steamboat (92), Veysonnaz (93, 95), Morzine (94), Lenzerheide (95), Semmering I (95, 96), Maribor (97). Giant slalom: Lake Louise (91). Super-g: Cortina (94), Lake Louise (96). Combined: Sierra Nevada (94), Lenzerheide (95).
Other feats - Gold medal giant slalom 1992 Olympics, gold medal combined 1994 Olympics, gold medal giant slalom 1991 world championships, gold medals slalom and combined 1996 world championships
Wiberg has been a regular on the World Cup circuit since 1990. This season she has her sights firmly set on the women's overall title. She would also like to clinch the slalom World Cup trophy.
